::: {.column-margin .dissertation-aside}
::: {.aside-highlight}
#### Highlight

I develop flexible machine-learning and AI methods for large scale data with the goal of uncovering hidden structures,
primarily in cancer biology and ecology
:::

#### Dissertation

In recognition of my doctoral dissertation, I received the [Savage Award in Applied Methodology](https://bayesian.org/project/savage-award/) at the 2025 Joint Statistical Meeting.
